variables.name: Precipitation
variables.definition: Rain and snow that falls from the sky, averaged per day.

variables.name: Evapotranspiration
variables.definition: Water that moves from soil, water surfaces and plants into the air.

variables.name: Surface runoff
variables.definition: Rain water that flows over the ground toward streams and lakes instead of soaking in.

variables.name: Soil moisture
variables.definition: How wet or dry the top layer of the ground is.

variables.name: Air temperature (2 m)
variables.definition: The air temperature 2 meters above the ground: the temperature we feel.

variables.name: Lake surface temperature
variables.definition: The temperature of the lake's surface, measured by the satellite in infrared.

variables.name: Tropospheric NO2
variables.definition: Nitrogen dioxide in the lower atmosphere, mostly from traffic and industry; a sign of air pollution.

variables.name: Air temperature at 500 hPa
variables.definition: Air temperature about 5.5 km above the ground (the 500 hPa pressure level), measured from space by AIRS.

variables.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
variables.definition: A number from 0 to 1 that shows how green and alive the plants are.
